title: Fixed Cutaway Box Drum and Internal Snare Bank

All visible numeric geometry is newly authored; no old loudspeaker cone/cabinet, kalimba body/tine, old stand or imported mesh is reused. One model zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR appearances, metres and Z up. Static stylized art only: no sound generation, tuning, authentic regional construction, snare vibration, playing or sitting load, physical safety, manufacture, rig, animation or interaction claimed.
